notes.title: Follow-up regarding Divine Dynamo Flamefrit's release
notes.notes:
To fans waiting for Flamefrit's release,

With the assistance of Valve, we were able to resolve the issue and have fully released Divine Dynamo Flamefrit.

Enjoy your adventures through the world of Hologard!

notes.title: Regarding the release of "Divine Dynamo Flamefrit"
notes.notes:
Dear fans awaiting the release of Flamefrit,

During our planned release of "Divine Dynamo Flamefrit" today, we have encountered an unforeseen error that is currently preventing the game from being released.

We have submitted a request for support with Valve to solve this issue, but unfortunately we will have to slightly delay the release until we are able to resolve the error.

We appreciate your patience and understanding on this matter.
